definition.content:
## NVIDIA Dynamo

This dashboard provides observability for your NVIDIA Dynamo distributed inference deployments with the Dynamo integration.

It shows request throughput, latency (time to first token and inter-token latency), queueing, KV cache usage and hit rate, and errors and rejections across the frontend and its workers.
Overview of the traffic served by your Dynamo frontends, the health of the scraped endpoints, and the status of the Dynamo monitors.
Request and token throughput at the Dynamo frontend, broken down by model.

Time to first token (TTFT) is dominated by queueing and prefill; inter-token latency (ITL) reflects decode speed. Averages are computed from the histogram sum and count, percentiles from the distribution.
Requests waiting for their first response and requests in flight. A growing queue with flat throughput means the deployment needs more workers.
GPU KV cache usage per worker component and the KV cache hit rate predicted by the KV-aware router. Usage close to 100% leads to preemptions and queueing; a low hit rate means little prefix reuse.
